note: v57.14 — SEC fiscal history moved to its own small artifact after it pushed the runtime summary past its 1 MiB budget; theme ranking gets a reading of where momentum is moving (P1440).

p.title: Fiscal history as its own artifact; sub-theme ranking reading
p.symptom: After P1439 unblocked the screener refresh, the next run failed at ci-sec-runtime-projection-check: 'runtime projection exceeds 1 MiB: 1515652' — the P1436 fiscalHistory objects inflated the pretty-printed summary. Separately, the 하위 테마 순위 table listed ranks and directions without saying what they add up to.
p.root_cause: P1436 put the multi-year series inside the bounded runtime summary instead of a separate projection.
p.fix: build-sec-runtime-projection.mjs writes public-data/sec-fiscal-history.json (compact, one 'YYYY-MM-DD:revenue:netIncome;…' string per issuer in USD millions, ~80 KB) and leaves the summary unchanged; lineage policy and refresh-screener staging added; fiscal-read.js loads it once via loadJsonArtifact and parses it (one-year fallback until it exists). page-flow themeStrengthLead: top three, leaders cooling (1-month rank well behind 3-month), sub-themes where momentum is moving, and how many leaders keep most members above the 50-day line.
p.violated_rule: Runtime artifact budgets are part of the interactive-path contract; a new series ships as its own bounded projection.
p.prevention: ci-sec-runtime-projection-check keeps the 1 MiB summary budget; ci-data-lineage-audit registers sec-fiscal-history.json (48 h).
p.verification: Local: projection functions produce '2021-01-31:16675:4332;…;2026-01-25:215938:120067' for NVDA; parser round-trips; theme lead reads '3개월 상위는 정유 · 서버/HW · 사이버보안. 그중 … 식는 중. 반대로 AI 칩/GPU · 메모리 · 파운드리/성숙공정은 …'. Live verification is the next refresh-screener run.

changelog: **재무 연도별 기록 분리 · 테마 순위 해석 (P1440):** 재무 공시의 여러 해 기록을 별도 작은 파일로 분리해 데이터 크기 상한 문제를 해결했고, 하위 테마 순위 위에 '강세가 식는 테마 / 단기 흐름이 옮겨 가는 테마' 해석을 붙였습니다.
